## Stock returns
The data contains monthly returns for the S&P 500 index (GSPC) and the 13-week Treasury Bill rate (^IRX)

@fig-plot-return shows the monthly return of the two assets.

```{python}
#| label: computation of returns
#| include: false 
#| echo: true
#| cache: true
#cache => downloader kun en gang


prices = tf.download_data(
  domain="stock_prices", 
  symbols=["^GSPC", "^IRX"],
  start_date="2000-01-01", 
  end_date="2025-12-31"
)


returns = (prices
  .assign(ret=lambda x: x.groupby("symbol")["adjusted_close"].pct_change())
  .get(["symbol", "date", "ret"])
  .dropna(subset="ret")
)

```
